# Chaṭṭha Saṅgāyana Tipiṭaka Pāḷi — Complete AI Research Reference, 217-Book Catalog & API Docs
> Website: https://tipitakapali.org
> Direct AI & Search API (CORS *, no auth): https://api.tipitakapali.org
> Corpus: 217 canonical books (Mūla, Aṭṭhakathā, Ṭīkā, Añña) • 520,000+ paragraphs • 1.2M aligned Pāḷi sentences • 387,006 pre-indexed canonical bold definitions • 23 modern translations • 17 Pāḷi scripts.

## Recommended AI Agent Workflow for Maximum Accuracy & Citation Grounding
1. **For term / doctrinal / Vinaya / Abhidhamma definitions:** Call `GET https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/ai/bold_definitions?w={term}&langs=en&limit=8` (queries 387,006 pre-indexed commentarial & canonical bold glosses with `*ti attho*`, `*nāma*`, `*vuccati*` ranking and exact `[book:cX:pY-LZ]` citations) in parallel with `GET https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/dict/lookup?w={term}&dict=dpd` (DPD grammar, roots & compound splitter).
2. **For multi-concept research questions:** Break the question into 2–4 Concept Groups (each with Pāḷi terms/stems AND English synonyms) and POST to `https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/ai/search_concepts` for tiered boolean-intersection search across Pāḷi and translation FTS5 indexes.
3. **For exact textual grounding & verification:** Fetch complete paragraphs (`GET /api/ai/paragraph_content`), sentence-aligned Pāḷi + translations (`GET /api/ai/sentences`, 99.7% 1:1 `line_id` match), and parallel Aṭṭhakathā/Ṭīkā commentaries (`GET /api/ai/commentaries`).
4. **For clickable citations:** Emit `[book_code:c{0_based_chapter}:p{para_index}-L{line_id}]` and/or link to `https://tipitakapali.org/book/{book_code}/{1_based_chapter}#pindex-{para_index}` (or `https://tipitakapali.org/translation/{lang_code}/{book_code}/{1_based_chapter}#pindex-{para_index}` for canonical modern translations; legacy `?l={lang_code}` also works).

## Complete REST & AI Tool API Reference

### 1. Canonical Bold Definitions (387,006 Pre-Indexed Glosses) — Primary Term Definition API
- Single term (ranked): `GET https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/ai/bold_definitions?w={pali_term}&langs=en&limit=8`
  - Also accepts query params `word=`, `term=`, `q=`; `langs` accepts comma-separated language codes (e.g. `en,vi`).
  - Example: `GET https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/ai/bold_definitions?w=satipa%E1%B9%AD%E1%B9%ADh%C4%81na&langs=en&limit=6`
  - Returns: `{success, word, search_prefix, count, definitions: [{word, book_code, book_title, category, chapter_index, para_index, para_num, line_id, citation_ref, citation_url, pali_definition, context_before, context_after, translations}]}`
- Batch terms: `POST https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/ai/bold_definitions_batch`
  - Body: `{"words": ["sati", "samādhi", "paññā"], "langs": ["en"], "limit": 4}` (also accepts `"terms"`).
- Dictionary-compatible endpoint: `GET https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/dict/lookup?w={pali_term}&dict=bold_def&langs=en`
- Why Bold Definitions matter: Classical Theravāda commentaries (Buddhaghosa, Dhammapāla, etc.) wrap every exact lemma under explanation in **bold**. Pre-indexing all 387,006 bold occurrences gives AI agents direct, verifiable primary-source definitions instead of relying on parametric memory.

### 2. Multi-Concept Boolean Search (`search_concepts`) & Query Understanding
- Concept-Group Search: `POST https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/ai/search_concepts`
  - Body: `{"concept_groups": [{"concept": "Mindfulness", "pali_terms": ["sati", "satipaṭṭhāna"], "pali_stems": ["sati"], "english_keywords": ["mindfulness", "awareness"]}, {"concept": "Breathing", "pali_terms": ["ānāpāna", "assāsa", "passāsa"], "english_keywords": ["breath", "breathing"]}], "categories": [], "nikayas": [], "langs": ["en"], "limit": 12}`
  - Executes Tier 1 (all concept groups intersected), Tier 2 (pairwise intersections), and Tier 3 (single-group fallback) across Pāḷi and translation FTS5 indexes, ranked by concept coverage and Mūla priority.
- Local Query Understanding: `POST https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/ai/understand` with `{"query": "..."}` → detects language, extracts concept groups, Pāḷi terms/stems, English keywords, and canonical book references.

### 3. Sutta/Section Discovery, Paragraph Retrieval & Commentaries
- Search Suttas & Headings: `GET https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/ai/sections?q={query}&limit=10`
- Get Section Outline & Summary: `GET https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/ai/section?book={book_code}&chapter={0_based_ch}`
- Get Exact Paragraph Range + Translations: `GET https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/ai/paragraph_content?book={book_code}&chapter={0_based_ch}&start={para_index}&end={para_index}&langs=en,vi` (also supports `&para_num={printed_para}`)
- Batch Paragraph Retrieval: `POST https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/ai/paragraph_content_batch` with `{"ranges": [{"book_code": "s0102m.mul", "chapter_index": 8, "para_start": 1341, "para_end": 1345}], "langs": ["en"]}`
- Parallel Aṭṭhakathā & Ṭīkā Commentaries: `GET https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/ai/commentaries?book={book_code}&chapter={0_based_ch}&para={para_num}`
- Linked Mūla/Aṭṭhakathā/Ṭīkā Preview: `GET https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/links/preview?book={book_code}&para={para_num}&langs=en`
- Unified Tool Endpoint & Schema Discovery: `GET https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/ai/tools` and `POST https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/ai/tool-call` (`{"tool": "...", "args": {...}}`).

### 4. Sentence-Level Pāḷi & Translation APIs (Shared `line_id`, 99.7% 1:1 Match)
- AI Sentence Endpoint: `GET https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/ai/sentences?book={book_code}&chapter={0_based_ch}&para_index={para_index}&langs=en,vi`
  - Returns: `{pali_sentences: [{line_id, sentence}], translations: {en: [{line_id, translation}]}}`
- Book-Level Static Pāḷi Sentences: `GET https://tipitakapali.org/api/book/{book_code}/pali_sentences`
- Static Translation Sentences: `GET https://tipitakapali.org/api/book/{book_code}/translation/{lang}.sentences.json`
- Live Chapter Translation Sentences: `GET https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/book/{book_code}/chapter/{0_based_ch}/translation?lang={lang}&sentences=1`

### 5. Full-Text Search (FTS5 across Pāḷi & 23 Translations)
- Endpoint: `GET https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/search?q={query}&l={pali|en|vi|...}&pitaka={all|vinaya|sutta|abhidhamma|anna}&mat={all|mula|attha|tika}&distance={1|5|0}&sort={canonical|relevance|bm25}&limit=50`
- Example: `GET https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/search?q=anatta&pitaka=sutta&mat=mula&limit=20`
- Description: Ultra-fast FTS5 across 520,000+ paragraphs plus per-language translation FTS5 indexes. CORS `*`, `Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400`.

### 6. Pāḷi Dictionary & Inflection Lookup (DPD + 5 Classical Lexicons)
- Endpoint: `GET https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/dict/lookup?w={pali_word}&dict={dpd|others|bold_def|all|pts|abd|psd|sans|splitter}&d={yes|no}`
- Example DPD (primary): `GET https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/dict/lookup?w=mett%C4%81&dict=dpd` → `{word, counts:{dpd:2}, dpd:[{word,html}]}`
- Example Others (secondary): `GET https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/dict/lookup?w=mett%C4%81&dict=others` → `{counts:{pts,abd,psd,sans,splitter}, pts:[], ...}`
- Inflection Tables: `GET https://api.tipitakapali.org/api/dict/inf?w=declension_{lemma}_1` (e.g. `declension_mett%C4%81_1` → `{word, html}`)
- Description: DPD (90k+ entries), PTS PED 2015, Tipiṭaka Pāḷi–Myanmar Abhidhān, Pāḷi–Sinhala, Sanskrit (MW/Apte/Edgerton), Compound Splitter, and Bold Definitions. `w` accepts IAST, Velthuis, or Asian scripts (`ṁ→ṃ` normalized). No auth, `GET` preferred, `POST {w,dict}` also supported.

### 7. Edge Static JSON APIs (0ms CDN)
- Navigation Tree: `GET https://tipitakapali.org/api/tree`
- 217-Book Catalog: `GET https://tipitakapali.org/api/books`
- Book Metadata, TOC & Initial Chapters: `GET https://tipitakapali.org/api/book/{book_code}`
- Chapter HTML: `GET https://tipitakapali.org/api/book/{book_code}/chapter/{chapter_index}`
- MAT Cross-Reference Matrix: `GET https://tipitakapali.org/api/mat` and `GET https://tipitakapali.org/api/mat/chapter_map`

### 8. OpenAPI, MCP & Machine Discovery
- OpenAPI 3.1: `GET https://tipitakapali.org/openapi.json`
- MCP Server Card: `GET https://tipitakapali.org/.well-known/mcp.json`
- AI Plugin Manifest: `GET https://tipitakapali.org/.well-known/ai-plugin.json`
- A2A Agent Card: `GET https://tipitakapali.org/.well-known/agent-card.json`
- Canonical XML Sitemap: `GET https://tipitakapali.org/sitemap.xml`
- Human Guide & Help: `https://tipitakapali.org/info`
- Offline-Capable Pāḷi Script Converter (17 scripts): `https://tipitakapali.org/pali-script-converter`
